cases.name: Renee Bergeron
cases.about: Renee was a licensed cosmetologist and worked some time as a hotel concierge. Her family noted that Renee was a caring mother, devoted to her daughter.
cases.narrative: On 11/14/1993, her body was found off the I-10 Service Road in Theodore, AL. She had been decapitated, and her sexual organs were mutilated.
